newsitem.title: USA: Group asks Baldwin to hire adviser.
newsitem.headline: Group asks Baldwin to hire adviser.

text.p: A group led by Newport Beach, Calif., investor Kenneth Pavia said Monday it had requested the board of Baldwin Piano & Organ Co to hire a nationally recognized investment banker to explore the possible sale, merger or business combination of the company.
The group, which holds a 6.0 percent stake in Baldwin, disclosed the move in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The group said it made the proposal with a view to enhancing the company's value to shareholders.
The group said that if its request is rejected, it will present a proposal to the annual meeting of Baldwin seeking shareholder support for its objective.
The group said its latest transactions on Baldwin include the purchase of 16,000 shares between July 19 and September 4 at prices ranging from $15 to $15.50 a share.
The group said it now holds 204,560 common shares.
